## Definition of done

- [ ] Focused tests were added first and now pass.
- [ ] `make ci` passes from a clean checkout, or the failing gate and owner are documented below.
- [ ] Generated contracts were produced with `make generate`, not edited manually.
- [ ] OCR editor flow evidence attached: process/import page, edit line or word text, save, reload, and verify the change persists.
- [ ] Export evidence attached when annotations changed: plain text plus hOCR, PAGE XML, or ALTO XML as applicable.
- [ ] Security and operations impact considered: tenant isolation, authorization, input cost, secrets/logs, idempotency, retries, and recovery.
- [ ] API, architecture, configuration, or operator documentation was updated when behavior changed.
